title: IT Support Executive
description:
**Job Title:** IT Support Executive

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Company:** Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS)

**About Us**

Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a fast-growing and innovative organization focused on transforming the healthcare industry. We specialize in delivering high-quality medical billing solutions and end-to-end revenue cycle management services, including accounts receivable (A/R) management and related healthcare operations.

With over nine years of experience, we proudly serve Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US-based healthcare organization. At HUMS, we are committed to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement as we expand our global footprint.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and proactive System Administrator & IT Executive to manage, maintain, and optimize our IT infrastructure. The role involves ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of systems, servers, and networks while providing technical support across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor, maintain, and support servers, systems, and computer networks to ensure optimal performance and uptime
* Perform regular system checks, software updates, patch management, and troubleshooting
* Manage and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs
* Ensure network security, stability, and seamless connectivity across departments
* Provide end-user technical support for hardware, software, and connectivity issues
* Manage data backups, disaster recovery processes, and data security compliance
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance strategies to reduce system downtime
* Coordinate with external vendors for procurement, maintenance, and technical support
* Maintain IT documentation and ensure adherence to internal IT policies and procedures

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Minimum 3 years of experience in system administration or IT support roles
* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux operating systems and server administration
* Good understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and VPNs
* Hands-on experience with networking devices such as Cisco switches/routers preferred
* Familiarity with firewall management and access control policies
* Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, MCSA, or CCNA are preferred
* AWS Cloud knowledge is an added advantage
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and interpersonal skills
* International Voice Support & Coordination

**Additional Information**

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion and are committed to creating a supportive workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary (including EPF and PS)
* Health insurance coverage
* 4-day work week (Monday to Thursday)
* Career growth and professional development opportunities
* Additional benefits such as food and cab-drop facility

**Application Process**

Interested candidates may send their resume and cover letter highlighting relevant experience and suitability for the role.

For queries, contact: **recruitment@hupcfl.com**

**Note:** Interviews and calls will be conducted between **05:45 PM – 04:45 AM IST**, Monday to Thursday.

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: IT & Systems Administrator
description:
**About MetroCorps**

MetroCorps Private Limited is a newly established project management company in Gachibowli, Hyderabad, delivering engineering design, procurement and project controls for design-build projects of US clients across Africa, the GCC and Europe. Every project is designed through conceptual, developmental, pre-final and final stages with licensed US Professional Engineers, and taken from the first page of the RFP to handover. Our programme includes modular and containerised living units, substation renovation, medium-voltage switchgear, UPS and generator systems, wastewater treatment plants and building renovation. Join our founding team.

**Employer:** MetroCorps Private Limited, Gachibowli, Hyderabad (www.metrocorps.com).

**The role**

We are building the founding team of our Hyderabad office and are looking for an IT & Systems Administrator to run our Microsoft 365 environment and office IT. You will look after users, devices, security and backups, and be the first line of support for a small international team.

**What you will do**

* Administer Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive, user accounts and licences.
* Manage identity and security in Entra ID: multi-factor authentication, conditional access and security baselines.
* Enrol and manage laptops and mobile devices with Intune; set up new joiners and close accounts for leavers.
* Run backups and test restores regularly.
* Administer engineering and business software, licences and renewals.
* Look after the office network, Wi-Fi, printers and meeting-room equipment, and manage IT vendors.
* Provide first-line support to users and keep clear IT documentation.

**What we are looking for**

* B.E./B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc. or MCA in Computer Science or IT.
* 3–6 years of systems administration, including hands-on Microsoft 365 tenant administration.
* Practical experience with Entra ID, Intune, MFA and conditional access.
* Backups and restores actually performed, not only designed.
* A relevant Microsoft certification is an advantage.
* Experience administering engineering software (for example AutoCAD or Revit) and its licences is an advantage.
* Good documentation habits and a responsive, hands-on support attitude.

**What we offer**

* Annual CTC of ₹6–12 lakh.
* A founding-team role: shape how a new international office works, from day one.
* International projects: design-build work for US clients, delivered to US standards.
* Work alongside licensed US Professional Engineers.
* A performance and pay review every year.

We value capability and commitment over years of experience.

**Location**

Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana. On site, full-time.

**How to apply**

Apply on this page: complete the short form and attach your CV. Every application is reviewed by our team. Shortlisted candidates take an online assessment, followed by technical interviews with our leadership team.

description:

**Job description**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands\-on IT Administrator to manage, maintain, and secure the organization's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for administering Windows servers and Active Directory, managing virtualization and firewall environments, ensuring network reliability, and supporting end\-user systems and devices. This role calls for a proactive professional who can keep infrastructure available, secure, and performing at its best while providing day\-to\-day technical support to users.

**Key Responsibilities :**

Administer and maintain Windows Servers and Active Directory, including creating and managing user accounts, resetting passwords, and configuring and implementing group policies.

Set up, configure, and maintain Hyper\-V virtualization environments, including regular update and upgrade checks on virtual and physical servers.

Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot firewalls (preferably SonicWALL), including firewall policy and role reviews, updates, and upgrades.

Manage domain controller (DC) and log servers, ensuring timely updates, upgrades, and health checks.

Install, update, and monitor anti\-virus and endpoint security software across servers and workstations.

Provide end\-user support: format and re\-image laptops and tablets, reinstall operating systems, install required software, and troubleshoot hardware and physical device issues.

Configure and maintain routers, Wi\-Fi networks, and printers, and troubleshoot networking, terminal\-connection, and connectivity issues.

Install, manage, and verify the working status of employee tracking and monitoring tools, CCTV cameras, and interactive boards.

Maintain accurate asset inventory and credentials documentation.

Help tune performance and ensure high availability of the IT infrastructure.

Manage infrastructure monitoring and reporting tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications :** 

2 to 4 years of experience in IT administration or a similar role.

Experience with Windows Servers and Active Directory.

Must have experience setting up a Hyper\-V virtualization environment.

Firewall configuration and maintenance experience, preferably SonicWALL.

Experience helping tune performance and ensure high availability of infrastructure.

Ability to manage infrastructure monitoring and reporting tools.

**Preferred Attributes :**

Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, firewalls, and end\-user hardware.

Ability to manage and support IT operations.

Good documentation habits and attention to detail in maintaining asset and credential records.

Self\-driven, reliable, and able to work with minimal supervision.

title: Technical Support Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Support Manager** to lead, mentor, and scale B2B SaaS support operations. This role is accountable for delivering exceptional customer experiences, building a high\-performing technical support team, and driving cross\-functional collaboration to resolve complex customer issues. The ideal candidate has a proven background in B2B SaaS, preferably within hospitality technology, strong people leadership skills, and a practical understanding of how modern AI tools can improve support quality, efficiency, and scalability.

 **Job Responsibilities**

**People Leadership \& Support Operations**

* Lead, coach, and scale a team of Technical Support Engineers delivering support across global communication channels, including chat, email, and phone.
* Establish, monitor, and improve key support metrics, including CSAT, Time to First Response, Mean Time to Resolution, and SLA compliance.
* Drive individual and team performance through regular one\-on\-ones, skill assessments, performance reviews, and career development planning.
* Promote clear ownership, accountability, urgency, and consistency in customer\-facing support execution.

**Cross\-Departmental Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Technical Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success.
* Establish feedback loops that convert support ticket trends, recurring defects, and customer pain points into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams.
* Partner with Customer Success to manage critical account escalations, protect high\-value customer relationships, and improve retention outcomes.
* Ensure escalations are clearly documented, prioritized, and resolved with appropriate urgency and follow\-through.

**AI \& Process Optimization**

* Evaluate, integrate, and champion AI\-driven tools such as auto\-triage, generative AI response drafting, automated ticket routing, and predictive analytics.
* Improve self\-service capabilities by strengthening knowledge base quality, AI\-powered search, and support documentation workflows.
* Balance automation with a high\-touch customer experience, ensuring efficiency gains do not reduce customer trust or issue ownership.
* Continuously identify workflow gaps, manual bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve support scale without sacrificing quality.

 **Job Requirements**

* **Experience \-** Seeking a candidate with experience of 5\+ years in technical support, including at least 2 years in direct people management leading technical teams.
* **Domain Expertise \-** Strong background in B2B SaaS models. Hospitality technology experience, including PMS, POS, or guest management systems, is highly preferred.
* **Technical Skills \-** Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, database querying, system integrations, and enterprise support tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Jira.
* **AI Exposure \-** Hands\-on experience or demonstrated strategic understanding of incorporating AI tools into modern technical support workflows.
* **Leadership \-** Proven ability to mentor staff, manage high\-pressure client escalations, and build a collaborative, accountability\-driven team culture.

 **Success Profile**

The successful candidate will combine technical fluency, disciplined operational management, and strong people leadership. They should be comfortable operating in a fast\-moving B2B SaaS environment, translating customer issues into business and product insights, and using AI\-enabled tools to improve support speed, consistency, and scalability.

 **Work Schedule:**


This position requires working in 24/7 rotational shifts, including evenings, late nights, and weekends. The role will be working in a hybrid work mode, with a minimum of two days required in the office each week, based in Hyderabad or Gurugram.

 **EEO Statement:**


Cendyn provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. title: System Administrator
description:
**Job description:**

Job Overview:  
We are seeking a skilled Windows and Network System Administrator with expertise in VMware technologies to manage our Windows\-based infrastructure, virtualized environments, and network systems at Rhinexa India Pvt. Ltd. This role focuses on administering Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, VMware virtualization, basic networking, and antivirus solutions while handling day\-to\-day system administration tasks. The ideal candidate will excel in communication and problem\-solving to support users and maintain seamless operations.

Key Responsibilities:

* Administer Windows Server environments (e.g., Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\), including installation, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Active Directory services, including user/group management, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), domain controllers, and LDAP integration for secure access control.
* Oversee Microsoft Exchange Server or Microsoft 365 Exchange Online, managing email configurations, mailbox policies, spam filtering, and high availability.
* Deploy and manage VMware virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter), including virtual machine creation, resource allocation, and performance optimization.
* Monitor and maintain network infrastructure, including routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall configurations to ensure connectivity and security.
* Implement and manage antivirus and endpoint protection solutions (e.g., Microsoft Defender, TrendMicro, Kaspersky) to detect and mitigate security threats.
* Handle day\-to\-day system administration tasks, such as user account provisioning, hardware/software troubleshooting, backups, restores, and system performance tuning.
* Perform VMware\-related tasks, including vMotion, DRS, HA configurations, and integration with Windows and network environments.
* Provide technical support to end\-users via ticketing systems, remote assistance, or on\-site help, communicating solutions clearly and effectively.
* Collaborate with IT teams on system upgrades, migrations (e.g., to Azure AD, hybrid cloud, or VMware\-based solutions), and maintain detailed documentation.
* Conduct system audits, vulnerability assessments, and compliance checks to align with Rhinexa’s cybersecurity and operational standards.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in system administration, with strong expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, and VMware technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows technologies, including Active Directory (AD DS, AD FS), Group Policies, and PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Proficiency in VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter, including VM management, clustering, and storage configurations (e.g., vSAN).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Exchange administration, including hybrid setups, DAGs (Database Availability Groups), and Outlook/OWA integration.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and tools for monitoring network performance.
* Experience with antivirus/EDR solutions and best practices for malware protection and incident response.
* Certifications such as Microsoft MCSA/MCSE, VMware VCP\-DCV, or CompTIA Network\+ are highly preferred.
* Excellent communication skills to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users and document procedures clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to manage complex, day\-to\-day IT challenges independently or collaboratively.

Preferred Skills:

* Knowledge of backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, VMware vSphere Data Protection) and disaster recovery planning.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating Windows and VMware tasks.
